correctness.rationale: Adjacent-one pairs follow from carry parity: precisely at 4^j−1. The greedy two-letter arch theorem is proved and applied to the literal 11011001 prefix, whose first three arches account for five ones. Each subsequent one completes exactly one arch unless the cutoff ends after the second adjacent one, yielding the indicator at N=4^j+1. The binary regular-language count yields F_(m+2) at N=2^m. Independent generator and next-occurrence dynamic checks were executed from the packaged verifier; finite checks corroborate but are not used as the infinite proof.
